name: weworkremotely
description: We Work Remotely (weworkremotely.com) is a remote job board. This CLI reads the public RSS feeds to list the latest remote jobs, either across all categories or within one category.

commands.name: list-jobs
commands.summary: List the latest remote job postings across all categories (public RSS feed)

commands.name: list-category-jobs
commands.summary: List the latest remote job postings in one job category, such as full-stack programming, design or devops (public RSS feed)

params.name: category
params.description: Category slug as used in the site's /categories/ URLs (without .rss). Verified slugs: remote-full-stack-programming-jobs, remote-design-jobs, remote-devops-sysadmin-jobs. Other categories follow the s

notes: A Cloudflare bot check blocks every HTML page, including the homepage, keyword search (/remote-jobs/search?term=), search RSS (/remote-jobs/search.rss) and job detail pages. Only the public RSS feeds work, so the CLI has no keyword search, filter, paging or job-detail command.
Each feed returns only the most recent postings and has no pagination. To filter by region, type or skills, filter the returned items on the client side.
Item titles use the format 'Company: Job Title'. 'link' and 'guid' hold the job's page URL on weworkremotely.com, which is behind Cloudflare and may not load without a browser.
'description' contains the full job posting as HTML and can be large, so request it explicitly only when needed. The country, state and skills fields are often empty strings.
The feeds declare ttl 60 minutes, so polling more often than about once an hour returns no new data.
